title: dryopteris chrysodioides
intro: Dryopteris chrysodioides, commonly known as golden shield fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. It is a type of vascular plant that has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The golden shield fern is said to have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions in reducing pain and improving overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
